title: From Waste Problem to Small Business

body.en: Vanessa used to see the plastic sachets piling up around her neighbourhood as just a mess somebody else should deal with. Then she learned that shredded and compressed, that same plastic waste could be turned into paving blocks and sold to local building sites. She started small — a hand press, a few bags of collected sachets, weekends only. Eighteen months later, she employs two other women part-time and supplies three ongoing construction sites. The waste didn't go away because someone banned it. It went away because someone found a way to make it worth collecting.

followUpQuestion: What turned a waste problem in Vanessa's neighbourhood into a business opportunity?
